title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slips 0.7% to $65,810 as fear and greed hits 33. Network hashrate stays solid at 866.8 EH/s while the mempool backs up to 92,511 transactions with fees at just 2 sat/vB. Block 959,117 confirms steady production.

Asia session opens with thin volume and no clear catalyst. Watch for any bounce attempt above 66k or a deeper test of 65k support as sentiment stays defensive. Low fees suggest room for buyers if dip buying emerges.
